caption: We trained the bot on a short text about a test shop. It answered a return question with the right 14 day window, and for Norway and gift cards it said it ships only within the Netherlands, could not confirm gift cards and offered a person.
We started the trial without a card: the banner asks us to add a payment method before the trial ends on December 4, 2026. Our Launch plan shows 1 agent at $29.99 per agent, billed monthly.
Cancelling takes two steps: the red Cancel subscription button, then a dialog where we had to type the word subscription before Confirm worked. Access stays until the end of the billing period.
After Confirm, EazyChat said our subscription was cancelled and that we keep access until Dec 4, 2026.
